source.detail: DAC1 line 1010 (total ODA, net disbursements), flow 1140, of each EU27 member; for EU Institutions (918), its line 1010 less the line 2102 (contributions to EU Institutions), flow 1140, of every provider other than 918 and the aggregates (codes from 20000), the United Kingdom included
source.sql: SELECT donor_code, year, value FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 18, 21, 22, 30, 40, 45, 50, 61, 62, 68, 69, 72, 75, 76, 77, 82, 83, 84) AND aidtype_code = 1010 AND flows_code = 1140 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year IN (2019, 2023) UNION ALL SELECT 918, year, sum(CASE WHEN donor_code = 918 AND aidtype_code = 1010 THEN value WHEN donor_code <> 918 AND donor_code < 20000 AND aidtype_code = 2102 THEN -value ELSE 0 END) FROM {dac1} WHERE aidtype_code IN (1010, 2102) AND flows_code = 1140 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year IN (2019, 2023) GROUP BY year

source.detail: DAC1, provider 20001 (DAC countries), line 12000 (multilateral ODA, grant equivalent), flow 1160
source.sql: SELECT 'dac_countries', year, sum(value) FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code = 20001 AND aidtype_code = 12000 AND flows_code = 1160 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year IN (2019, 2023) GROUP BY ALL

source.sql: SELECT 'dac_countries', year, sum(value) FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code = 20001 AND aidtype_code = 1820 AND flows_code = 1160 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year IN (2022, 2023) GROUP BY ALL
SELECT 'dac_countries', year, sum(value) FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code = 20001 AND aidtype_code = 1 AND flows_code = 1140 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year IN (2010, 2023) GROUP BY ALL
SELECT 'dac_countries', year, sum(value) FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code = 20001 AND aidtype_code = 1600 AND flows_code = 1140 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year IN (2005, 2006) GROUP BY ALL

source.detail: DAC1, provider 20001, line 11030 (private sector instruments), flow 1160
source.sql: SELECT 'dac_countries', year, sum(value) FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code = 20001 AND aidtype_code = 11030 AND flows_code = 1160 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year IN (2023) GROUP BY ALL

source.detail: DAC1: 100 x line 11010 (flow 1160) of EU Institutions (918) over the summed line 1 (GNI, flow 1140) of the 28 EU members of 2019, the United Kingdom included
source.sql: SELECT 918, 2019, 100 * (SELECT value FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code = 918 AND aidtype_code = 11010 AND flows_code = 1160 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year = 2019) / (SELECT sum(value) FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 18, 21, 22, 30, 40, 45, 50, 61, 62, 68, 69, 72, 75, 76, 77, 82, 83, 84, 12) AND aidtype_code = 1 AND flows_code = 1140 AND amounttype_code = 'A' AND year = 2019)

source.detail: DAC1 constant-price rows (amount type D, 2024 USD), line 1010 (total ODA, net disbursements), flow 1140, for France, Germany, the United Kingdom, the United States, Japan and provider 20001 (DAC countries)
source.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN donor_code = 20001 THEN 'dac_countries' ELSE CAST(donor_code AS VARCHAR) END, year, sum(value) FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code IN (4, 5, 12, 302, 701, 20001) AND aidtype_code = 1010 AND flows_code = 1140 AND amounttype_code = 'D' AND year IN (2000, 2010, 2024) GROUP BY ALL

source.detail: DAC1 constant-price rows (amount type D, 2024 USD), line 11010 (total ODA, grant equivalent), flow 1160, for France, Germany, the United Kingdom, the United States, Japan and provider 20001 (DAC countries)
source.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN donor_code = 20001 THEN 'dac_countries' ELSE CAST(donor_code AS VARCHAR) END, year, sum(value) FROM {dac1} WHERE donor_code IN (4, 5, 12, 302, 701, 20001) AND aidtype_code = 11010 AND flows_code = 1160 AND amounttype_code = 'D' AND year IN (2018, 2021, 2024) GROUP BY ALL
